universal-healthcare.reason: Access to care for everyone is a good goal, though mechanisms vary.

raise-minimum-wage.reason: Full-time work should not leave people in poverty.

markets-allocate-better.reason: Markets are often efficient but fail in some areas.

public-ownership.reason: Public ownership of major industries tends to work worse than regulated markets.

tax-the-wealthy.reason: Progressive taxation is reasonable, though "much larger" is vague.

unions-good.reason: Unions generally help workers' bargaining power despite some downsides.

property-fundamental.reason: Property rights matter but should be overridable with good cause and compensation.

regulate-corporations.reason: Depends on the industry; strictness should fit the risk.

worker-ownership.reason: Appealing in some cases but not as a general rule.

surveillance-ok.reason: Trade-off between security and privacy; depends on safeguards.

legalize-drugs.reason: Reasonable arguments both ways; decriminalization seems stronger than full legalization.

restrict-hate-speech.reason: Broad legal restrictions risk chilling speech, though incitement limits are fine.

strong-leader.reason: Bypassing checks creates serious risks of abuse.

state-harmful.reason: Abolishing the state would likely produce worse outcomes.

limit-guns.reason: Some limits are sensible, but "strictly" varies by context.

legalize-sex-work.reason: Consenting adults' choices should be legal, with worker protections.

decide-locally.reason: Subsidiarity is often good but some matters need larger scales.

traditional-family.reason: Many family forms can support healthy societies.

abortion-legal.reason: Abortion legal in most cases is a defensible position, though a contested moral question.

more-religion-public.reason: Public life works better with religion as a private matter, plural and neutral.

correct-racial-injustice.reason: Addressing documented past injustices is reasonable, depending on methods.

gender-social-construct.reason: Largely true in how gender roles are shaped, though biology plays a part.

preserve-national-culture.reason: Cultural heritage has value worth preserving.

gradual-change.reason: Incremental reform usually avoids unintended harm.

reduce-immigration.reason: Tight restriction seems excessive; managed immigration is better.

empower-international-orgs.reason: Enforcement powers against states raise sovereignty and legitimacy problems.

free-trade.reason: Trade generally raises overall wealth, though with uneven distribution.

nation-first.reason: Global cooperation often serves national interests too.

humanitarian-intervention.reason: Sometimes intervention is needed to stop atrocities, so "never" is too strong.

limit-growth.reason: Growth can be decoupled from environmental harm; limits aren't the main answer.

drastic-climate-action.reason: Climate change warrants strong government action.

tech-solves-problems.reason: Technology helps a lot but won't solve most problems alone.

revolution-justified.reason: Revolution can occasionally be justified against severe tyranny.

experts-over-public.reason: Public input matters for legitimacy; experts should advise.

central-planning.reason: Central planning has performed poorly historically.

socialized-markets.reason: Worker cooperatives are fine but should not be required.

land-value-tax.reason: Land value taxes are appealing but replacing most taxes is too strong.

basic-income.reason: Interesting idea with real tradeoffs; I'm torn.

tariffs-protect-industry.reason: Tariffs usually cost more than they protect.

state-directs-investment.reason: Sometimes useful, but state picking often fails.

widespread-small-property.reason: Wide ownership is nice; no strong view.

abolish-central-banks.reason: Central banks have a useful role.

corporatist-bargaining.reason: State-mandated bargaining bodies seem overly rigid.

one-party-rule.reason: Exclusive party rule is incompatible with accountability.
